_comment: Local meeting note-taker config (Windows). recordings_dir is where recorder.py drops finished captures; watcher.py polls it, transcribes via OpenAI Whisper (OPENAI_API_KEY in root .env), drafts a MOM, and uploads via the v0 storage pipeline. recorder.py auto-runs watcher --once after Ctrl-C (auto_process) and watcher pushes audio+transcript+MOM to the personal Drive (auto_upload). engine=openai only - no Gemini, no whisper.cpp. To use gemini/whispercpp instead set engine=auto|cli|whispercpp.
